contribution.concept: Syntax-aware entity embedding for neural relation extraction

evidence.evidence: In this paper, we propose to learn syntax-aware entity embedding for neural relation extraction.

We conduct experiments on a widely used real-world dataset and the experimental results show that our model can make full use of all informative instances and achieve state-of-the-art performance of relation extraction.

method.concept: Combining sentence and entity embeddings for relation classification

evidence.evidence: Finally, we combine both sentence embedding and entity embedding for relation classification.
